svg.title: Grade 8 U01 L14 original geometric proof
svg.desc: Original model: horizontal parallel lines y=0 and y=2, red transversal y=tan(63 degrees)x, intersection at (0,0) and (2/tan(63 degrees),2). Matching acute alternate interior angles are 63 degrees; adjacent supplements are 117 degrees. This is not publisher art.
svg.text: 63° acute angle, 117° supplementary; two parallel lines
